title: Kenyan-Style Keto Beef Wraps
description: Spicy beef and vegetables wrapped in a crispy low-carb wrap, inspired by the flavors of Kenya. A delicious keto meal option.

ingredients.name: Beef strips
ingredients.notes: Choose a lean cut for a keto-friendly option.

ingredients.name: Tangy slaw mix
ingredients.notes: Look for a store-bought or homemade mix that's low in sugar.

ingredients.name: Quick pickled vegetables
ingredients.notes: Use a mixture of cucumbers, carrots, and bell peppers for added crunch.

ingredients.name: Low-carb wrap
ingredients.notes: Choose a brand that's specifically labeled as low-carb or keto-friendly.

ingredients.name: Fix seasoning
ingredients.notes: Use a blend that's low in sugar and salt for a keto-friendly option.

ingredients.name: Vegetables
ingredients.notes: Add any additional vegetables you like, such as bell peppers or onions.

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.notes: Choose a neutral-tasting oil like avocado or grapeseed.

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Season the beef strips with fix seasoning and cook to your liking, about 5-7 minutes per side.
3. Meanwhile, toast the low-carb wraps by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven at 350°F for 5-7 minutes.
4. Assemble the wraps by adding the cooked beef, tangy slaw mix, quick pickled vegetables, and any additional vegetables you like.
5. Drizzle with oil and serve immediately.
